description: Changes who can open an app. visibility: private (the owner and invited people), workspace (everyone at the owner's company), or public (anyone with the link, guests included). invite adds people by email and sends each an email; remove takes people off the list. Do this only when the person asks for it. Returns the resulting sharing.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

invite.description: Email addresses to give access to.

remove.description: Email addresses to take off the access list.

visibility.description: New sharing mode. Leave out to keep the current one.

name: share_app
title: Share an app
